name: KE NJIA country agent (Swahili, English)
first_message: Habari! Karibu NJIA. Mimi ni Baraka, msaidizi wa AI. Simu hii inaweza kurekodiwa kwa ajili ya demo. Nikusaidie vipi leo?
voice_note: Same voice as Juma (KE_ID). Baraka replaces Neema, Juma, Amani and Zawadi.

permit.label: Market permit
permit.when: The caller wants to renew or check a market stall or business permit (not an ID card).

lost_id.label: Lost ID
lost_id.when: The caller's national ID is lost, stolen or damaged, or they want a new or 'renewed' ID because of that, or ask about an ID they reported lost (including a refund of its fee or the fingerprint appointment).

passport.label: Passport
passport.when: The caller asks about renewing a Kenyan passport, its fees or the biometrics appointment, in Kenya or abroad (London, Berlin).

health.label: Health cover
health.when: The caller asks about health cover, contributions, a hospital cover confirmation or adding a newborn, or someone is very unwell or it is an emergency.

disability.label: Disability tax exemption
disability.when: The caller asks about the disability tax exemption or their disability registration.

triage_note: Was claude-haiku-4-5 (S0). On the first Kenya call it asked for ID again on a service change and started the service itself; T1 caught it promising a call-back after a failed create_case. Haiku saved about $0.07 a call.
